verdict.rationale: Metronome has a thoroughly documented public API. The docs cover bearer-token authentication, pagination, idempotency, custom fields, and endpoint references for billable metrics, contracts, and ingest. Official SDKs exist in five languages, a Postman collection is available, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, which suit agent-driven use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
